family_basis: Adjacent Volume 2 correspondence items, each explicitly framed on the authorized publisher page as a response to incoming correspondence. This is a research grouping, not a claim that the three letters concern one event or recipient.
verification_scope: Direct authorized publisher item page inspected for stable aid, letter number, displayed date, response framing, signature/byline and publisher witness note where exposed. Underlying incoming letters and physical manuscript/secretariat copies were not inspected.

items.title: אגרות קודש - מכתב קסט

items.verification_limit: Incoming correspondence and the underlying secretariat copy were not independently inspected.
items.duplicate_review: No duplicate with the other two promoted items: distinct stable aid and letter number.

items.duplicate_review: No duplicate with the other two promoted items: distinct stable aid and letter number.

epistemic_note: Verified here applies to the authorized published item-level witness and the claims explicitly visible on it. It does not verify missing incoming correspondence, reconstruct context, or establish manuscript-level identity.
